welcomeSubtitle: Play PS5 games on your Mac. Let's set a few things up first.
chooseThemeSubtitle: You can change it later in Settings, or use your own picture or video.
chooseFolderSubtitle: Choose the folder that holds your PS5 dumps. Subfolders are scanned too, and new games show up on their own.
updateAvailable: Can be installed again with the new version
startingText: The game is opening, please wait. The first start can take a few minutes while the game gets ready for the Mac.
frameGenerationDetail: Experimental · a frame between each two; turns on vertical sync
frameGenerationLowPower: Low Power Mode is on: the display stays at 60 Hz, so frame generation cannot work
folderNoGames: There is no PS5 game in that folder
useGamesFolderDetail: It holds %d games: %@. The launcher looks for games there too from now on.
addFolderDetail: For games on another drive or in another folder
removeFolderAsk: Remove “%@” from the library? Its games leave the list; nothing on the drive is touched.
linkCopied: Link copied: opening it shows this game in the launcher
saveSyncDetail: Saves and trophies stay the same on your other Macs through %@
saveSyncNoFolder: Saves and trophies stay the same on your other Macs through a folder; choose one first
syncFolderNone: None: choose iCloud Drive, Dropbox or a shared folder
clipsDetail: Create, ⌥F12 or the phone saves the last %d seconds to the gallery
clipsNeedPermissionDetail: Allow AnyPS5 in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording
clipsOffDetail: Turn them on in Settings → Behaviour → Clips
clipSavedDetail: The last %d seconds · the game's settings → Screenshots
clipFailed: The clip could not be saved
lowPowerFrameGeneration: The display stays at 60 Hz, so frame generation cannot work. Turn it off in System Settings → Battery.
lowPowerRefresh: The display stays at 60 Hz, so the game stops at 60 fps. Turn it off in System Settings → Battery.
uninstallConfirm: Remove the installation? Your game files stay; the game shows as locked again.
installedSize: Installed games are kept as APFS clones and take no extra space.
aboutText: AnyPS5 runs PS5 games on the Mac through Rosetta and MoltenVK.
hideWhilePlaying: Hide the launcher while a game runs
rosettaMissing: Games run through Rosetta, which this Mac does not have yet.
moveToApplicationsText: macOS opens downloaded apps from a locked, read-only copy. Let me move it to Applications and reopen it, so this never gets in the way again.
noToolkit: This copy has no conversion tools. Use AnyPS5.app from the release.
emptyLibraryText: Put PS5 dumps in your games folder and they show up here on their own.
unreadableDump: This dump is encrypted or damaged and cannot be opened.
togetherIntroDetail: Your profile, trophies and friends, online. No password: a code by email or from the website.
togetherWithWebsiteDetail: Get a code here, type it on your phone or any computer
togetherSignedOutElsewhere: Signed out of AnyTogether from another device
togetherCodeExpired: The code has expired; ask for a new one
togetherCodeLocked: Too many wrong codes; ask for a new one
togetherTooMany: Too many codes for now; try again later
togetherWithPhoneDetail: If %@ is signed in to AnyTogether, one tap there approves it

profileMineDetail: Your games, play time and trophies
togetherNoLinks: Names and bios can't carry links
partyStartDetail: Invite friends, play and talk together
partyOpenDetail: Your friends can walk in without an invite
partyKicked: You were removed from the party
togetherServerInvalid: Type an https:// address (http:// only for this Mac)

messagesGroupPick: Pick at least one friend first
friendsSignIn: Sign in to see your friends
friendsYourHandle: Yours is @%@: give it to your friends

themesDetail: Yours and the ones people share

themeSaveFailed: The theme could not be saved

shareThemeDetail: Saves the file and opens the page to send it
shareThemeHint: The theme in use, from the Studio
themeShareNext: Attach the file on the page that opened

trophyHiddenDetail: Shows what it is once you earn it.
alwaysShowHiddenTrophiesDetail: Hidden trophies show their name and description before you earn them
phonePairingText: The phone shows the same code.
phoneOpenLauncher: %@ wants to connect: open the launcher to allow it.
phoneServerFailed: The phone connection could not start
phoneConnectedDetail: mController is ready: play with the phone
phoneWaiting: %@: becomes a player at its first press
updateChoiceText: An update is ready for this game
updateAndPlayDetail: Brings AnyPS5's latest fixes; your saves and trophies stay
discordPresence: Show the game you play on Discord

gameMusicDetail: The selected game's own theme song, when it has one
checkUpdatesDetail: Tells you when a new AnyPS5 is out
screenshotsNone: None yet: press F12 in the game
backUpSavesDetail: Saves and trophies, into Documents → AnyPS5 → Backups
restoreSavesDetail: The game's current saves are backed up first
updateCheckFailed: Could not check for updates: GitHub did not answer

makeReportDetail: To attach on Discord or GitHub
screenshotsHint: F12 in a game saves a screenshot. The system fonts games get are in Settings → Fonts.

exportSettingsDetail: Keys and every setting in one file
importSettingsDetail: Applies a settings file someone shared

updateChannelStableDetail: Releases, tried before they come out

updateChannelStays: Staying on %@ until a newer stable release comes out
profilePictureDetail: Shown on the top bar in place of your initial
profilePictureUploadDetail: Friends see it on your profile
profilePictureFromTogetherDetail: The picture on your AnyTogether profile, on this Mac too
privatePictureFailed: The picture could not be uploaded
profilePictureUnreadable: That file is not a picture that can be read
profilePictureTooSmall: The picture is too small: at least 32 pixels
profilePictureDownloadFailed: Your AnyTogether picture could not be downloaded

askKick: Remove %@ from the party? They need a new invite to come back.
askEndTogether: End Play Together for everyone? The others stay in their game, alone.

askStopShare: Stop share play? Everyone watching is let go.

requiredTooOldVersion: AnyPS5 %@ is too old for AnyTogether

requiredDownloadDetail: Opens the downloads page in your browser
updateRequiredToast: AnyTogether needs AnyPS5 %@ or newer: Settings → About

assistShareDetail: %@ helps you play player 1 instead of playing their own
gyroDetail: Turn the controller or the phone to move the right stick
gyroActivationDetail: L2 suits aiming down the sights

broadcastSettingsDetail: Stream the game live to Twitch, YouTube or any RTMP server
broadcastServerDetail: rtmp:// or rtmps:// address; the key can be at its end
broadcastKeyDetail: From your channel's dashboard. Never show it on stream

broadcastReconnecting: Connection lost · trying again in %d s

broadcastNoMicrophone: The microphone is not allowed; the broadcast goes on without it

browserPlayDetail: A phone scans a QR code and its browser is the pad
browserPlayOff: Off: nothing is served on the network
browserPlayShowDetail: Scan it with the phone's camera
browserPlayKeepDetail: Phones let in before can come back without a new code while AnyPS5 is open
browserPlayStep1: Join the same Wi-Fi as this Mac.

browserPlayNoNetwork:
No local network.
Join Wi-Fi or Ethernet.

reportReading: Reading the log and macOS's crash report…

sharePlayFull: Nobody else can watch right now
socialFeedSubtitle: What your friends have been playing
socialFeedRowDetail: Friends' trophies, first plays and milestones

socialBoardUnlisted: You're not on this board: it only lists people whose trophies and library are public

steamGamesDetail: Every unlocked game as its own Steam entry with its art, starting straight into the game
steamRemoveDetail: Takes out only AnyPS5's entries and their pictures
steamRunningDetail: Steam writes over its shortcuts when it quits: quit it first, or let AnyPS5 quit it.
steamAdded: Added to Steam: %@. Open Steam to find it in the AnyPS5 collection.
steamRemoved: AnyPS5 is no longer in Steam
steamWouldNotClose: Steam did not quit. Quit it from its menu, then try again.
